column1: # Draft picks seed — the source of truth for the Contract Outlook draft-capital annotation.
# Manually maintained: add ONLY verified pick ownership. Do not invent picks.
# `bun run seed:draft-picks` validates every row and replaces the draft_picks table.
# Team codes may be entered in RealGM notation and are canonicalized at seed time.
# RealGM diverges from standard NBA codes for five teams:
# Basketball-Reference codes CHO→CHA and PHO→PHX are also accepted (plausible paste source).
#   team        ORIGINATING team (3-letter UPPER) — its record sets the pick value.
#   owner_team  CONTROLLING team (3-letter UPPER) — whose Contract Outlook card it shows on.
#   year        draft year (2025-2035; 2025 already conveyed and is ignored on render).
#   protections free-text; must match a canonical key (unprotected | top-1 protected |
#               top-3 protected | top-4 protected | top-5 protected | top-10 protected |
#               lottery protected) or it is stored verbatim and priced at the 0.70 default.
#               keep-if-top-N construct ("1-N Own; rest conveys") -> "top-N protected"
